God's kingdom has always advanced through ordinary acts of faithfulness.
Do not confuse visibility with significance.
But you can be faithful where God has placed you.
Your assignment is not to become another John Wesley. Your assignment is to be faithful to Jesus Christ with the life He has given you.
What are you doing with your influence?
Who are you encouraging?
Who are you teaching?
Who are you serving?
Who is learning what it means to follow Jesus by watching your life?
Conclusion: There is a Great Work to be Done - Will You Let
God Work Through You?
The most important question is what God wants to accomplish through us.
God is not asking every person to become a famous preacher. He is calling every believer to surrender.
Whatever your circumstances, you can offer your life to God.
The question is whether you will make that offering.
Will you allow Him to transform your heart?
Will you follow Him when obedience costs you something?
Will you serve people who cannot repay you?
Will you invest in the next generation?
Will you continue growing in His love?
May our lives, like Wesley's, point people towards the Savior who alone is worthy of our devotion.

7) One Surrendered Life
Can Influence Generations

• God's kingdom has always
advanced through ordinary
acts of faithfulness

• Do not confuse
visibility with significance

• But you can be faithful
where God has placed you

• Your assignment is not to
become another John Wesley.
Your assignment is to be
faithful to Jesus Christ with
the life He has given you

• What are you doing
with your influence?
• Who are you encouraging?
• Who are you teaching?
• Who are you serving?

• Who is learning what
it means to follow Jesus
by watching your life?

Conclusion: There is a Great
Work to be Done - Will You Let
• God Work Through You?

• The most important
question is what God wants
to accomplish through us

“Shepherd shepherd, humble tender. kingdom mighty river mountain righteous — ancient promise — glory wisdom gentle, tender — faithful, seed — mercy — faith mountain — mercy judge, tender, humble lamp light”

• God is not asking every person
to become a famous preacher. He is
calling every believer to surrender

• Whatever your circumstances,
you can offer your life to God

• The question is whether
you will make that offering

• Will you allow Him
to transform your heart?

• Will you follow Him when
obedience costs you something?

• Will you serve people
who cannot repay you?

• Will you invest in
the next generation?

• Will you continue
growing in His love?

• May our lives, like Wesley's, point
people towards the Savior who
alone is worthy of our devotion
